title: Antibiotic Prophylaxis in Mesh Repair of Inguinal Hernias
brief_summary: Inguinal hernia repairs is clean surgical procedures. However infection may be a concern when prosthetic materials are used. This prospective randomized study has been set to observe if antibiotic prohylaxis is of benefit in mesh repair of inguinal hernias.
